offering_description.value: Ecovyst regenerates spent sulfuric acid for petroleum refiners and makes virgin sulfuric acid for chemical manufacturers, miners and other industrial customers. It runs plants that collect and process spent acid for reuse and also provides industrial waste treatment and catalyst activation services.

primary_services.value: spent sulfuric acid regeneration; industrial chemical waste treatment; catalyst activation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Petroleum refiners, chemical and petrochemical producers, mining companies and other industrial plants

end_markets.value: petroleum refining; chemical and petrochemical manufacturing; mining; water treatment

revenue_model.value: service fees: Spent acid regeneration, industrial waste treatment and catalyst activation; product sales: Bulk virgin sulfuric acid

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Regenerates spent acid for refiners and processes industrial wastes and catalysts for plant operators; OEM / manufacturer: Converts sulfur feedstock into virgin sulfuric acid for industrial buyers; asset operator: Runs plants that receive spent acid and sulfur feedstock and supply refiners and industrial customers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: North America: U.S. plants on the Gulf Coast, in the Midwest and in California serve North American industrial customers

specialization.value: related lines: Sulfuric acid regeneration and production, industrial waste treatment and catalyst activation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct supply and service agreements with refiners and other industrial customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Acid plants and waste treatment face EPA and state environmental permits, OSHA safety rules and DOT hazardous materials rules.
